suggestions: reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
optimized_sql:
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       SUM(sub.sum_qty)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sub.cnt_qty), 0) AS agg1,
       SUM(sub.sum_list_price)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sub.cnt_list_price), 0) AS agg2,
       SUM(sub.sum_coupon_amt)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sub.cnt_coupon_amt), 0) AS agg3,
       SUM(sub.sum_sales_price)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sub.cnt_sales_price), 0) AS agg4
FROM (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk,
           COUNT(ss.ss_quantity) AS cnt_qty,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sum_qty,
           COUNT(ss.ss_list_price) AS cnt_list_price,
           SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS sum_list_price,
           COUNT(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_coupon_amt,
           SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_coupon_amt,
           COUNT(ss.ss_sales_price) AS cnt_sales_price,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales_price
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion AS p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
      AND (p.p_channel_email = 'N' OR p.p_channel_event = 'N')
      AND dd.d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk
) AS sub
JOIN item AS i ON sub.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id
ORDER BY i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
